title: TimesFM 3.0 (Google Research)
claim: A 330M-parameter zero-shot model natively trained for multivariate forecasting with past and known-future covariates such as weather forecasts.
why_relevant: Covariate-capable foundation model released inside our scored window, so weeks-after-weights matters.

title: Forecasting Associations, Not Interventions: A Preregistered Causal Audit of Covariate-Aware Time Series Foundation Models
claim: Chronos-2, TiRex-2, TabPFN-TS and TimesFM-2.5 respond to a covariate like an observational regression, so their what-if answers are confounded.
why_relevant: Bears on how far to trust the covariate response of the models we run; synthetic and physical systems, not load.

title: Online Conditional Vine Copulas: Forecasting Electricity Demand
claim: An online covariate-conditioned vine copula model beats unconditional benchmarks on GB net-demand across five regions and updates cheaply.
why_relevant: Probabilistic regional demand with covariates; horizon and weather use not stated.
